personality_one_liner: Pure white minimalist focus with sharp royal blue accents, keeping the mission front and center without visual noise.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Use iOS-native spacing rhythms. Empty space is intentional. Touch targets ≥ 44x44pt.

do's: Use for floating action buttons (FAB), sticky headers over scrollable lists, and bottom sheet headers.
Apply to the background of bottom tabs if used, or sticky bottom primary CTAs.
dont's: Do not use on regular cards, list rows, or standard buttons.
Do not over-blur; ensure pure white 'zéro distraction' feel is maintained.

screens.name: SplashScreen
screens.purpose: A welcoming entry introducing the app's mission and slogan.

states.loading: Centered white spinner over the minimalist church background.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a minimalist cross/church. Apply a dark gradient scrim (top to bottom). The text 'UDAMG APP' and the slogan 'Sauvé par Grâce pour Sauver' should be placed cleanly in the center-bottom, using `onSurfaceInverse`.

screens.name: LoginPage
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for church members and administrators.

states.loading: Button shows loading spinner upon submission.
states.error: Standard error toast or inline text under inputs.

screens.layout: Pure white background. Large, accessible input fields (Email, Password) with labels above inputs. Sticky primary CTA 'Se Connecter' in royal blue pinned to the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: MenuPrincipal
screens.purpose: The central Hub to direct users to either Evangelism or Events.
screens.layout: Split-screen landing menu. Two massive stacked cards taking equal vertical space in the center. Card 1: 'POLE 1 - Évangélisation' with a subtle tinted icon or background image. Card 2: 'POLE 2 - Événements'. Both should have pure white or very light gray backgrounds, sharp blue accents, and large hit areas. Minimalist header 'Menu Principal' at the top.

screens.name: PageVilles
screens.purpose: Select a city to filter evangelism cells.

states.error: Message 'Erreur de chargement' with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top with glass effect. A clean list of cities using full-width rows (surfaceSecondary or surface), with a right-aligned royal blue chevron.

screens.name: PageFamilles
screens.purpose: List spiritual families/cells (e.g., Gédéon, Moins de 18 ans) for the selected city.
screens.layout: Header shows selected Ville. Minimalist cards for each family. Each card displays the family name, meeting time/location, and a group icon. Card margins should be generous (lg padding).

screens.name: ContactListPage
screens.purpose: A minimalist, alphabetized directory of contacts for follow-up.
screens.layout: Top search bar. Content is an alphabetized list (A, B, C section headers in muted text). Each row has an initials avatar (brandTertiary bg with royal blue text), Nom, Prénom, and smaller subtitle for 'famille reference'. A floating action button (FAB) in royal blue sits bottom-right for 'Ajouter un contact'.

screens.name: FormulaireContact
screens.purpose: Quick-add contact bottom sheet triggered from ContactListPage.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet modal using `@gorhom/bottom-sheet`. Minimalist handle. Single-column form: Nom, Prénom, Téléphone, Famille (dropdown/select). Sticky primary button 'Enregistrer' at the bottom of the sheet.

screens.name: EventsList
screens.purpose: Calendar and list of upcoming church events.
screens.layout: Horizontal scrollable date strip or monthly grid calendar at the top. Below, vertically scrollable event cards showing date, heure, lieu, thématique, and type (sorties, veillées, cultes spéciaux). Cards use generous white space, subtle shadow 1, and royal blue accents for dates or 'Inviter' CTAs.

screens.name: EventDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of an event with participant tracking and roles.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top (church or worship gathering) overlaid with a dark vertical gradient scrim and event title. Below: details section (lieu, intervenants), a dashboard block tracking participants, and role assignments. Floating sticky button at bottom to 'S'inscrire' or manage.

screens.name: InviteElders
screens.purpose: Special mobilization module to invite specific church members (anciens).
screens.layout: A specialized contact selection list with checkboxes. A 'Spécial ✨' badge in royal blue/gold. Top summary shows 'X sélectionnés'. Sticky bottom button 'Envoyer l'invitation'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Large initials avatar centered at the top. A block of user stats (contacts added, events attended). A simple vertical list of settings options and a 'Se déconnecter' button in error red.

splash_bg.alt: A minimalist white church roof with a cross against a clear blue sky

event_hero_worship.alt: A crowd of people with arms raised in worship

hub_evangelism_cover.alt: Community group of friends meeting outdoors

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the requested 'Fond blanc pur minimaliste' (pure white backgrounds #FFFFFF) paired with 'bleu roi' (Royal Blue #0047AB) for interactive and accent elements. This is a deliberate override of the default blue ban.
For the Hub screen (MenuPrincipal), divide the screen into two large, equal-sized touch targets for the two poles. This reduces decision friction and emphasizes the app's dual-mission focus.
Implement the ContactListPage as an alphabetized directory. Ensure there is generous white space and the primary action to add a contact is housed in a Floating Action Button (FAB).
The FormulaireContact must be a Bottom Sheet modal (@gorhom/bottom-sheet). Ensure the background of the sheet respects the pure white minimal aesthetics with a clean drag handle.
Any text overlaid on imagery (e.g., SplashScreen, EventDetail hero) MUST feature a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to dark) and text positioned in the bottom 30% for WCAG compliance.
Use French terminology across the UI exactly as requested: 'Menu Principal', 'Évangélisation', 'Événements', 'Ajouter un contact', 'Inviter les anciens', 'Sauvé par Grâce pour Sauver'.
